propositions: The reconciler lacks infrastructure to select a backend at runtime; vendor choice is currently implicit in which module is imported.

A new `backend` field on `ReconcilerConfig` must be added to `src/rebar/_config_schema.py` with a default value of `"jira"` and static validation via `_as_choice` coercer to reject unknown keys at config-load time.

A module-level registry with `register()` decorator and `select_backend(config)` resolver must be implemented in `_backend_registry.py`, using lazy in-function import of adapters to avoid circular imports and ensure deterministic registration.
JiraBackend must be decorated with `@register("jira", factory)` in its module, and `adapters/__init__.py` must import it to fire the registration side-effect.
select_backend() must read `config.reconciler.backend`, look up the registered factory, construct and return a Backend instance; unknown keys bypass the config-load guard raise a registry error.
No existing consumer code (`_load_acli`, AcliClient construction sites, differ/apply modules) is modified in this story; consumer rewiring is deferred to story S4.
